attchmntText: GHCL Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: GHCL Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 2, 2026. Revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was INR821 crores, up 11% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR202 crores with a margin of 24.7%. Profit after tax was INR127 crores. The company commenced commercial production of vacuum salt and bromine. The Board approved INR88 crores for a railway siding and INR450 crores for salt works expansion. Global soda ash demand remains flattish due to oversupply, while Indian demand is supported by solar glass capacity growth. The company maintains a net cash surplus of over INR1,070 crores.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 06, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited approved the execution of a Shareholders Agreement with TPG SG Arca Pte Ltd for TPG's proposed investment in step-down subsidiary Arka Fincap Limited. The agreement records rights and obligations among Kirloskar Oil Engines, wholly owned subsidiary Arka Financial Holdings Private Limited, Arka Fincap, and TPG. TPG will subscribe to equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares in two tranches. The first tranche involves an investment of INR 525,00,00,003 for 100 equity shares and 32,53,45,231 preference shares. The second tranche involves an investment of INR 275,00,00,588 for 12,93,34,496 preference shares, subject to business milestones and regulatory approvals. Post-investment, Kirloskar Oil Engines will hold 62.607% of Arka Fincap. The agreement grants TPG one nominee director and certain minority protection rights. There is no impact on the management or control of Kirloskar Oil Engines.

attchmntText: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "TML CV Holdings B.V., an Indirect Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) ( the Company )   Voluntary Totalitarian Tender Offer for all the common shares of Iveco Group N.V.".
voiceSummary: Tata Motors Limited disclosed that its subsidiary TML CV Holdings B.V. reached a provisional shareholding of 96.29% in Iveco Group N.V. following the reopening of a voluntary totalitarian tender offer. During the reopening, which ended on November 7, 2026, 18,309,029 common shares were tendered. The offer price is EUR 14.40 per share. Payment for these shares is scheduled for November 13, 2026. Due to exceeding the 95% threshold, the offeror intends to commence a Dutch legal squeeze-out for remaining shares. Final results will be announced by November 12, 2026. Trading in Iveco Group N.V. shares will be suspended.
